name: anneal
description: Enforced SDLC gates for Claude Code: skills for each phase, a deterministic CLI behind hooks, and calibrated judgement calls that run in shadow until they earn enforcement.

cf_account_id.title: Cloudflare account id
cf_account_id.description: Account that runs Clef on Workers AI. Leave empty to keep every Clef decision point off.

cf_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cf_api_token.description: Workers AI token for Clef calls. Stored as a secret.

clef_mode.title: Clef mode
clef_mode.description: off, shadow (log what Clef would decide) or enforce (act on it where calibration allows), optionally followed by per-point overrides such as shadow,D1=off,D3=enforce.
